issue.title: Stabilize test_artifacts_beads_populated_png_snapshot provider inventory
issue.description: On 2026-08-13, an isolated strict visual run on current HEAD fails test_artifacts_beads_populated_png_snapshot with 1,656 changed/1,655 material pixels; three Artifacts Plans nodes fail with the same top-strip/provider-inventory pattern (1,685-1,745 changed pixels). The snippet-pane-frame diff touches only prompt-bar styles/rendering/tests and reproduces these failures unchanged against HEAD. Existing retired umbrella sase-dl already notes that the current fixture exposes an ambient Plans provider absent from the golden, but its close forbids reopening broad drift. Make this node and its three directly related Artifacts-plan fixtures deterministic against provider installation/inventory, then update goldens only if the stabilized intended UI differs.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-dl — retired broad-drift umbrella containing the prior clean-master reproduction and the ambient Plans-provider diagnosis for this exact node.

Triage sweep 2026-08-14 (requested by the project owner: keep the seven highest-impact open tasks, close the rest). These are per-node visual-snapshot stabilizations (artifacts/beads provider inventory, frontmatter panel, preview panel reference, the low-alpha xterm-256 palette audit) plus the just test-visual-update blast-radius defect. The PNG suite is excluded from 'just test' and 'just test-cov', so none of these blocks the shared check/check-full gates, and today's 'tools/selection_health --fail-on-new-flake' run names 12 reproducible flakes, none of them a PNG node. The update-mode hazard in sase-lo is real but mitigated by review discipline (goldens land in a diff). Re-file with a +1 if a golden mismatch blocks a landing.

payload.close_reason: Deprioritized in the 2026-08-14 task-backlog triage: PNG-golden drift is contained by the dedicated just test-visual lane and is not blocking the shared gates.
